decision.cache_decision: retain existing dependency installation and setup-node policy; local ACT data did not measure hosted cache-service net benefit, so add no compiled cache
retained_gates: all three unconditional clean-room consumer profiles
Playwright Chromium install and npm run admin-ui:smoke

measurement_context.cache_limits: ACT action cache was offline; the synthetic local workflow omits setup-node npm cache-service integration. Measurements do not model hosted GitHub cache-service latency or x64 runner timings. No compiled Mix/Hex or clean-room consumer state is reused.
measurement_context.cache_method: cold then two warm runs per configuration using isolated persistent NPM_CONFIG_CACHE roots keyed by configuration and OTP
measurement_context.candidate_identity: Candidate workflow is a disposable, untracked security-gates-local.yml overlay; tracked security-gates.yml and its canonical Phase 73 proof remained unchanged during measurement. The candidate overlay removes only the duplicate Fast lane.
measurement_context.database: one fresh ephemeral PostgreSQL 16 instance per matrix run with isolated OTP-specific databases
measurement_context.host: Apple Silicon macOS host, Docker Desktop Linux VM
measurement_context.setup_accounting: measurement includes checkout, setup-beam, setup-node and all workflow commands; runner setup prelude is collected separately and added to setup_ms, job_ms and wall_ms
measurement_context.workflow_jobs: security OTP 27 and OTP 28 matrix jobs run concurrently
measurement_context.workflow_sha256_scope: Synthetic local workflow bytes with only sample-numbered measurement output paths normalized; policy and command content remain covered by the digest.

rejected_attempts.detail: The OTP 28 verification retry could not create a fresh Phase 07 database after a local DBConnection queue timeout. A complete fresh-database retry passed and is candidate-2.
